notes.title: 0.8.2 Update Description
notes.content:
Correction: Differences in the format of commas and dots in decimals in Europe and America caused game lag.
New: Custom song page, added open folder button (Steam version only)

notes.title: Significant update to version 0.8 of "Ninja - Waltz of night"
notes.content:
New beat mode, using music to drive game levels, supporting players to upload music to generate levels
Add a pause function during the game, activate it using the left hand menu keys
Adjusting player feedback levels 5/6/7 is too difficult, reducing the difficulty of these three levels
Adjusting the game interface and skill icons
Trailer Adventure Mode<Preview Version>You can try a simple little level in this version
In the newly added adventure mode, there is a treasure chest monster that can eat people, as a tribute to Xin Shi Ji Fulian

notes.title: V0.7 version update instructions
notes.content:
1. Updated scene elements and lighting
2. Adjusted the difficulty of levels 8, 10, and 11
3. Optimized the AI behavior of enemy characters

Trailer: There will be a new game mode in the next version
